subject: New model onboarding: m2-lite (8k) — eval & rollout plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: New model onboarding: m2-lite (8k) — eval & rollout plan

Hi team,

We received an early drop from Mistral (m2-lite 8k variant) and Product would like to get this into our onboarding queue. High-level asks:

- Can Infra/Runtime confirm kernel/attention compatibility and any KV cache implications?
- Ops: rough estimation for a staged rollout in Hosted, Dedicated, and Private modes (what differs per deployment).
- Security: any provenance/KMS concerns for private deployments (we may have customers request pinning for compliance).

Attached: model-profile-v1.pdf (spec sheet) and eval-prompt-set.csv (core prompt families to sanity-check). Want to land a concrete plan by EOD so we can communicate to partnerships.

Target constraints: prioritize low-latency hosted use cases, but also be ready to offer a pinned variant for Dedicated customers who ask for specific quantization.

Questions for discussion: is a temporary "staging pin" advisable for our safety/regression checks before committing to a long-lived pin? If so, recommended duration?

Thanks — Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Group PM, Serving & Models
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:22:14 -0700
Subject: Re: New model onboarding: m2-lite (8k) — eval & rollout plan

Thanks Jonas — quick technical readout from runtime side after an initial smoke run. Summary first:

- Model architecture looks standard transformer; attention kernel works on current kernels but we observed higher mem pressure at sequence lengths >4k.
- KV cache behavior: no surprises but the shape/order for cached tensors deviates slightly from our Llama-derivative assumptions; will need a small adapter in the cache layer to avoid reordering costs.
- Quantized 8-bit variants (per vendor quant profile) appear stable on test prompts, but we need the regression harness to cover streaming and function-calling workloads.

Recommended next steps (infra):
1) Compat sweep (2 days): run the full kernel matrix + long-seq stress tests (INF-4321).
2) Adapter PR to KV cache (small, targeted) and a rolling test in staging (3 days).
3) Pin suggestion: do a 10–14 day "staging pin" for hosted traffic while we collect perf/quality signals. If no regressions, convert to standard model entry and offer a 'long-term pin' option for Dedicated customers.

I attached a short draft compat report (compat-report-draft.md) with raw run notes and perf deltas.

Karthik
Staff Infra Engineer
--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:40 -0700
Subject: Re: New model onboarding: m2-lite (8k) — eval & rollout plan

Short note from Ops on rollout feasibility:

- Hosted: we can stage this as a variant behind a feature flag and route a small % of traffic (1–5%) for the 10–14 day pin window Karthik suggested. Need one full compat sweep and the staging metrics dashboard (latency, p95, token cost).
- Dedicated: for customers on reserved pools we can offer a pinned quantized artifact, but will require a QC pass for multi-instance consistency (some quant variants exhibited small sampling variance across cards during dev runs). Expect ~5 business days of validation for a single reserved pool.
- Private/on-prem: block until Security signs off on provenance + KMS flow. Also need to confirm the model artifact format matches our on-prem loader (some vendors ship sharded formats).

Playbook: I attached rollout-playbook.md with a suggested A/B and rollback plan. If we go ahead, Ops will spin up a staging slice and enable telemetry for the prompt families in eval-prompt-set.csv.

Marissa
Head of Inference Ops
--

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nicolas (Mistral) <nicolas@mistral.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: New model onboarding: m2-lite (8k) — eval & rollout plan

Looping in vendor contact for provenance questions. Quick security checklist items before Private deployment or pinned Dedicated artifacts: 

1) Model provenance statement and hash-signed artifact — we need vendor attestation and a signed SHA256 for the exact artifact we plan to distribute to customers.
2) KMS/HSM compatibility for keys used in private deployments — confirm the model encryption at rest workflow.
3) Data retention and telemetry: confirm there are no model-internal telemetry callbacks to vendor infra; we require zero outbound telemetry by default for Private.

Nicolas — can you confirm the artifact signing and provide the recommended quant profile manifest? If you have a published provenance page, link would help.

If vendor confirms quickly and provides signed artifacts, Security is comfortable with a hosted staging pin and a gated Dedicated release. Private releases must wait until we validate KMS integration in our staging environment.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance
--

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

- Infra (Karthik): run compat sweep (INF-4321) and land KV cache adapter. Target: compat sweep complete by 2026-08-05 EOD. Recommend a 10–14 day staging pin for hosted traffic.
- Ops (Marissa): stand up staging slice, enable telemetry for the eval prompt set, and prepare the rollout playbook. Target: staging flag ON by 2026-08-06.
- Security (Laura): confirm artifact signing and KMS compatibility with Mistral; Private releases blocked until KMS verified.
- Vendor (Nicolas): please share signed artifact SHA256 and quant profile manifest.

Attachments to this thread include the proposed-pin-policy.md draft that Product will use for comms with customers who ask to pin. If any party needs to push timelines, flag here by EOD tomorrow.

If no major blockers, we will communicate to Partnerships and start the external pilot next week.

Jonas
Group PM, Serving & Models
